title: AWS 13-hour outage caused by AI agent 'Kiro'
summary: Amazon AWS experienced a 13-hour disruption in Dec 2025 (reported Feb 2026) due to changes made by its in-house 'Kiro' agentic coding tool. Amazon blamed human oversight for the AI's error, highlighting the accountability gap in AI-driven deployments.

title: Optio: Orchestrate AI coding agents from ticket to PR
summary: Show HN project (87 pts) that automates the full coding lifecycle using Claude Code/Codex in isolated K8s pods. Specifically focuses on self-healing CI and autonomous merging of PRs once checks pass.

title: Agent Package Manager (APM) by Microsoft
summary: Microsoft/GitHub released APM to manage agent configuration dependencies (skills, plugins, MCP) with a lockfile (apm.lock) and supply-chain audits, targeting large scale enterprise needs.

title: G0: Control Layer for AI Agents
summary: A security and governance platform for AI agents (scan, test, monitor, comply). Explicitly supports OpenClaw architecture and 'cognitive drift monitoring'.

title: Uncoordinated parallel agents break production codebases
summary: Report on why multi-agent workspaces lead to broken production code: Git detects text-level conflicts but agents generate overlapping logic changes with partial, isolated context.
